Name: The Pumpkimos
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]Introducing the Pumpkimos. A small mod that changes your normal little[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Junimo friends into a cute round pumpkin version for fall. [/color]


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332435.png[/img]
[color=#d4d4d8]Configuration options are available for the following: spirits Eve only, half fall (fall 15- fall 30), all of Fall, or always.  [/color]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332579.png[/img]
Compatible with cute pumpkin junimos. Not really sure about anything else. Will address as we go.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332629.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/b].[/*]
[*]Install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/b].[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod's folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI[/*]
[/list]
[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332703.png[/img][/b]
Note: These are super cute.
